_說明: THP5（Tree House 5）文法、聽力與發音。cards＝課本 Grammar 頁小卡；questions＝文法題（choice 選擇、order 排句子）；listening＝用課本例句出的聽力題（lfill、lpick、lorder），加上發音聽辨（lpick、有 label）；phonics＝課本 Phonics 頁（例字用 [ ] 標出發這個音的字母）。a＝正確選項位置（從 0 開始），App 會打亂選項順序。

U1.title: and / but · Present Continuous · Past Continuous
U1.zh: 連接詞 and／but；現在進行式：現在正在做的事；過去進行式：過去某個時間正在做的事
rules: and：好事＋好事（＋, and ＋）
Chuck's dad turned on the TV, and Susie wrote her homework.
but：一正一反（＋, but －）
Susie likes to write English homework, but she doesn't like to write math homework.
現在進行式：am / is / are ＋ V-ing
Chuck's dad is putting down the fruit.
I → am；he / she / it → is；you / we / they → are
Chuck and Susie are standing by the sink.
過去進行式：was / were ＋ V-ing
Was Chuck turning off the computer at eleven o'clock?
I / he / she / it → was；you / we / they → were
Chuck's parents were sitting down at one o'clock.
phrases: Who is eating pizza?　What were you doing at one o'clock?
mistakes: She are standing by the sink.
She is standing by the sink.
she 用 is
They was sitting down at one o'clock.
They were sitting down at one o'clock.
they 用 were
Dad is put down the fruit.
Dad is putting down the fruit.
進行式動詞要加 -ing
I like cats, but I like dogs.
I like cats, and I like dogs.
兩件都是好事用 and

U2.title: time to / time for · before / after · when
U2.zh: 該做什麼的時間到了；在……之前／之後；當……的時候
rules: time to ＋ 動詞
"Tim, it's time to come inside!" yells Alice.
time for ＋ 名詞（bed, breakfast, school, a nap, a snack, a story, the test）
"It's time for school," said Wally's dad.
before / after ＋ 名詞（介系詞）
Alice woke up before breakfast.
before / after ＋ 句子（連接詞）
Tim will put on his pajamas after he runs upstairs.
when ＋ 句子：當……的時候
Kate and Jimmy felt excited when their cards blew away.
講未來時，when／after 後面用現在式
Wally will feel happy when he sits on the couch with his parents.
phrases: Did Wally go downstairs before he went to school?　Did Alice sing when she took a shower?
mistakes: It's time to bed.
It's time for bed.
bed 是名詞 → time for
It's time for eat.
It's time to eat.
eat 是動詞 → time to
Tim will put on his pajamas after he will run upstairs.
Tim will put on his pajamas after he runs upstairs.
講未來時，after 後面用現在式

U3.title: should · as · start / finish V-ing
U3.zh: 應該；一邊……一邊……（同時）；開始／做完某件事
rules: should ＋ 原形動詞：應該
Kate should put on her boots.
should not（shouldn't）：不應該
The boy should not hurry.
問句：Should ＋ 主詞 ＋ 原形動詞？
Should the woman answer her cell phone? No, she shouldn't answer her cell phone.
as：同時。過去式 as 過去式
The vendor watched TV as she cut up the guavas.
講未來：will ＋ 動詞 as ＋ 現在式
Grandma will make a mess as she waits for the bus.
start / finish ＋ V-ing
The children started putting on their boots at four o'clock.
phrases: The man will start doing magic tricks at 4:15.　The workers will finish making a pile of wood at 4:15.
mistakes: Kate should puts on her boots.
Kate should put on her boots.
should 後面用原形動詞
The children started put on their boots.
The children started putting on their boots.
start ＋ V-ing
Grandma will make a mess as she will wait for the bus.
Grandma will make a mess as she waits for the bus.
講未來時，as 後面用現在式

U4.title: will … in (time) · be going to · anyone / everyone …
U4.zh: 未來式：多久之後會……；打算要做……；不定代名詞（有人、大家、沒有人……）
rules: will ＋ 動詞 ＋ in ＋ 時間（in a minute＝一分鐘後）
Who will dig a hole in two months? Tim will dig a hole in two months.
will be ＋ 形容詞／名詞／地方
Susie will be angry in a week.
否定：won't
Tim won't be a scientist in two months.
be going to ＋ 原形動詞：打算要……
Chuck's dad is going to watch television.
問句：Are … going to …? 否定：isn't going to
Are Pam and her grandfather going to plant a tree? Yes, they are going to plant a tree.
anyone, everyone, someone, no one／anything, everything, something, nothing（當單數）
Everyone is in the science museum.
phrases: Is anyone looking at the tiger? No, no one is looking at the tiger.　Someone is sleeping on the bench.　Will Chuck eat anything? Yes, Chuck will eat everything.
mistakes: Susie will angry in a week.
Susie will be angry in a week.
will 後面接形容詞要加 be
Tim will digs a hole.
Tim will dig a hole.
will ＋ 原形動詞
Chuck's dad is going to watches TV.
Chuck's dad is going to watch TV.
going to ＋ 原形動詞
Everyone are in the museum.
Everyone is in the museum.
everyone 當單數 → is

U5.title: with (adj.) (n.) · Past Tense: ago · Past Tense: time phrases
U5.zh: 有……的（人／東西）；多久以前；用過去的時間詞要用過去式
rules: （人／東西）with ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞：有……的
The girl with big eyes talked on her cell phone.
The dog with the short tail played in a puddle.
時間 ＋ ago：……以前（ago＝before now），動詞用過去式
Susie drew a grasshopper thirty seconds ago.
When did …? → … ago
When did the fat boy chase his friend? He chased his friend four hours ago.
過去的時間詞：this morning, yesterday, last night, last week, last weekend, six months ago
Who played video games last weekend?
What did the girl with long hair do this morning? She fed the swan this morning.
mistakes: The girl has big eyes talked on her phone.
The girl with big eyes talked on her phone.
描述是哪一個人用 with
I eat lunch an hour ago.
I ate lunch an hour ago.
ago 是過去 → 過去式
I played games ago three days.
I played games three days ago.
ago 放在時間的後面

U6.title: as (adj.) as (n.) · get (adj.) · Be Verbs
U6.zh: 跟……一樣（形容詞）；變得……；be 動詞的過去、現在、未來
rules: as ＋ 形容詞 ＋ as ＋ 名詞：跟……一樣
The thin girl is as tall as the tree.
Who will be as excited as Wally? Becky will be as excited as Wally.
get ＋ 形容詞：變得……
Pam got excited as she watched the news on TV.
The little boy will get confused when the girl does a magic trick.
Be 動詞：過去 was / were；現在 am / is / are；未來 will be
Where were the students?
Bob will be a vendor.　Will Pam and the other children be famous?
mistakes: The girl is as tall the tree.
The girl is as tall as the tree.
as … as 兩個 as 都要有
Pam got excite.
Pam got excited.
get ＋ 形容詞（excited）
Tim and Susie isn't hot.
Tim and Susie aren't hot.
Tim and Susie＝they → are
Bob will is a vendor.
Bob will be a vendor.
will 後面用 be

U7.title: Prepositions of Movement · Past Continuous + when · should / will + if
U7.zh: 移動的介系詞；正在做某事的時候，突然發生另一件事；如果……就應該／會……
rules: across 穿越／along 沿著／around 繞著／between 在兩者之間／over 越過上方／through 穿過（裡面）
Wally walked around the bushes.
Susie and Becky were walking along the stream.
(was / were ＋ V-ing) when (過去式)：長時間的事 when 短時間的事
The bear was climbing a tree when it fell.
What were you doing when you heard a wolf?
should / will ＋ 原形動詞 ＋ if ＋ 現在式
What should you do if you see a bear? You should make a lot of noise if you see a bear.
Tim will hide if he sees a bear.
mistakes: The bear climbed a tree when it was falling.
The bear was climbing a tree when it fell.
長時間的事用進行式，短時間的事用過去式
Tim will hide if he will see a bear.
Tim will hide if he sees a bear.
if 後面用現在式
Jimmy should eats an apple.
Jimmy should eat an apple.
should ＋ 原形動詞

U8.title: Sensory Verbs · Comparative Adjectives · see / hear (something) V-ing
U8.zh: 感官動詞；比較級（比……更……）；看到／聽到某人正在做某事
rules: look / smell / sound / taste / feel ＋ 形容詞
How does the recorder sound? It sounds scary.
look / smell / sound / taste / feel ＋ like ＋ 名詞
What did the water taste like? It tasted like chicken.
一個音節：A be 形容詞-er than B
The pink butterfly is bigger than the yellow butterfly.
兩個以上音節：A be more 形容詞 than B（bad → worse）
The small egg is more colorful than the big egg.
see / hear ＋ 某人或某物 ＋ V-ing
Alice sees a mouse digging a hole.
Tim heard Alice talking loudly.
phrases: The mouse felt soft.　The ground smelled terrible.　The turtle looks like a dinosaur.　The gray pigeon was heavier than the purple pigeon.
mistakes: The mouse felt softly.
The mouse felt soft.
感官動詞後面接形容詞
The turtle looks a dinosaur.
The turtle looks like a dinosaur.
接名詞要加 like
The pink butterfly is more big than the yellow one.
The pink butterfly is bigger than the yellow one.
一個音節加 -er
Kate's hot dog was badder than Becky's.
Kate's hot dog was worse than Becky's.
bad 的比較級是 worse

U9.title: as (adv.) as … could · Superlative Adjectives · Adverbs
U9.zh: 盡可能地……；最高級（最……）；副詞：怎麼做
rules: 動詞 ＋ as ＋ 副詞 ＋ as ＋ 某人 ＋ could：盡可能地……
The goat jumped as high as it could.
How carefully did the farmers burn the leaves? They burned them as carefully as they could.
一個音節：A be the 形容詞-est
The blue turtle is the biggest.
兩個以上音節：A be the most 形容詞
Is the vendor with the purple shirt the most polite?
副詞（形容詞 ＋ ly）說明動作怎麼做
The fox crossed the road quickly.
Kate was laughing happily.
phrases: Were the thin pigs the hungriest?　The gray eagle was the fastest.　The truck driver isn't eating slowly.
mistakes: The goat jumped as high as it can.
The goat jumped as high as it could.
過去的事用 could
The blue turtle is the most big.
The blue turtle is the biggest.
一個音節 → the 形容詞-est
The fox crossed the road quick.
The fox crossed the road quickly.
說明動作用副詞 quickly
Kate was the most crazy.
Kate was the craziest.
crazy → y 改 i ＋ est
